newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk army gives evidence against Islamist party.
newsitem.headline: Turk army gives evidence against Islamist party.

text.p: Turkey's secularist military gave evidence on Thursday in support of a court case to close the Islam-based Welfare Party, the biggest party in parliament.
Anatolian news agency said prosecutors had accepted as evidence military documents on the party of former prime minister Necmettin Erbakan and passed them on to the Constitutional Court.

Chief state prosecutor Vural Savas in May opened a case to close the Islamist party on the grounds that it was threatening Turkey's secular constitution. Legal sources say the case is expected to last about six months.
Erbakan, the country's first Islamist leader, earlier this year alarmed Turkey's establishment with a series of mainly symbolic challenges to its secular traditions.
The clash between Welfare and the staunchly secular military led to Erbakan's resignation as prime minister last month.
His government has been replaced by an anti-Islamist coalition led by conservative Mesut Yilmaz, which faces a vote of confidence on July 12.
